log.raw: {"understanding":{"purpose":"Document the validation rule, a valid example, and the error message for each customer onboarding field.","tasks":["Find a field and read across its rule, valid example, and error message.","Compare rules or examples across fields when implementing or checking validation.","Read error messages in sequence when reviewing the customer-facing wording."],"relations":["Each row connects one field to its pattern, an example that should match it, and the message shown when validation fails.","The example helps interpret the pattern; the error message communicates the requirement to the user."],"roles":["The header identifies four distinct kinds of information.","Field names are row headers and anchors for horizontal lookup.","Patterns are precise technical specifications; examples are compact test values; error messages are readable prose."],"keep_whole":["Field identifiers, valid examples, and regex tokens should stay intact where space permits.","Numbers and punctuation within validation patterns and example values carry meaning and should remain easy to distinguish."],"may_wrap":["Error messages can wrap at natural word boundaries.","Long patterns may need to wrap, preferably at meaningful regex boundaries; narrow viewport-fitting columns can force less natural breaks."],"same_scale":["All field names share one column and should be easy to scan consistently.","Examples should have enough width to display typical values together; error messages benefit from a consistent prose measure."],"h_vs_v":"A viewport-fitting table avoids horizontal navigation but forces identifiers, patterns, and examples to break, making rows tall and harder to compare. Extra width preserves technical content and reduces height, at the cost of scrolling across each row."},"designs":[{"widths":[90,95,85,89],"strategy":"Fit within 359px for immediate access to all four columns, accepting substantial forced breaks and tall rows."},{"widths":[147,300,188,260],"strategy":"Use moderate horizontal scrolling to keep field names and examples whole while giving patterns and error messages practical wrapping space."},{"widths":[147,1095,285,300],"strategy":"Prioritize complete one-line patterns and examples for technical inspection, accepting extensive horizontal scrolling and a wide gap between field names and error messages."}]}
